name: Port Alberni Cogeneration
proponent: PanCanadian Petroleum Limited and ATCO Power Canada Limited

commitments.text:
1.  PAC must cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed and operated in accordance with 
the conditions of this certificate and the documents and commitments listed in Schedule A to this 
certificate (Schedule A).

4.(1) Despite Condition 1, if prior to start of land clearing and construction PAC proposes a change to the design, location, construction and operation of the Project that may have the potential for significant adverse effects, PAC must provide the Executive Director with notice of the proposed change and the plans, analysis, records and other information necessary for an effective assessment of the proposed change.

6.(2) PAC must comply with all applicable orders, directions and conditions, and obtain and comply with all applicable tenures, licences, regulations, approvals, standards and permits, or other authorities, which may include or result from the listed provincial enactments (including the Fish Protection Act, Heritage Conservation Act, Waste Management Act, Water Act and others).

8. Prior to commencement of construction of the Project, PAC must, to the reasonable satisfaction of the Executive Director, comply with all other conditions listed in the committee report and as agreed to by PAC, as well as with all commitments documented in Schedule A to this certificate.
9.(a) PAC must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started the Project by commencing construction within five (5) years of the issue date of this certificate.

9.(b) PAC must have submitted to the EAO, within three (3) months of start of construction, a report on compliance with the Conditions of this certificate, and the schedule for submitting monitoring reports to be completed pursuant to documents listed in Schedule A and defined in the committee report.
